questions.question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
questions.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(fld035(fld001 where YEAR(fld008) = 2011 and fld038 > 1000), COUNT(fld001) ) * 100;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld017) = '2011' AND T1.fld038 > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld020
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

questions.question: Based on posts posted by Community, calculate the percentage of posts that use the R language.

questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T3.fld034 = 'r', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T3 ON T3.fld036 = T2.fld005 WHERE T1.fld039 = 'Community'

questions.question: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?
questions.evidence: user no. 23853 refers to fld002 = '23853'; at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12 refers to fld008 = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'; not well-finished refers to fld031 IS NULL and vice versa
questions.SQL: SELECT IIF(T2.fld031 IS NULL, 'NOT well-finished', 'well-finished') AS resylt FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld005 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld002 = 23853 AND T1.fld008 = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT IIF(T2.ClosedDate IS NULL, 'NOT well-finished', 'well-finished') AS resylt FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 23853 AND T1.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

questions.question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
questions.evidence: The higher reputation the user has the more influence; percentage = DIVIDE(fld035(stats_posts.fld001 where fld006 > 50 and MAX(fld038))), COUNT(stats_posts.fld001 where MAX(fld038));
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld006 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld020 INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(fld038) AS max_reputation FROM tab07) AS T3 ON T1.fld038 = T3.max_reputation
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users T1 INNER JOIN posts T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users ) T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation

questions.question: Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popularity?

questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld039 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T3 ON T2.fld005 = T3.fld001 WHERE T1.fld039 = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR T1.fld039 = 'Noah Snyder' GROUP BY T1.fld039 ORDER BY SUM(T3.fld018) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
questions.evidence: calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(fld018 where fld039 = 'Mornington'), SUM(fld018 where fld039 = 'Amos'));
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.fld039 = 'Mornington', T3.fld018, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.fld039 = 'Amos', T3.fld018, 0)) AS diff FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T2.fld005
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Mornington', T3.ViewCount, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Amos', T3.ViewCount, 0)) AS diff FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId
